prompt: Here's a small semantic-search service — index a corpus of documents into a vector store, then answer queries by cosine similarity against the stored vectors. Ever since a teammate "upgraded" the embedding model on one side of the system, search quality has quietly tanked: relevant documents get buried and junk shows up near the top. There are no exceptions, no error logs, and the similarity scores still come back as perfectly plausible-looking floats. Look at the code below, diagnose what's actually going wrong, and explain how you'd confirm and fix it.
